instruction: Transpose Bend - Curl a Tapered Tail into a 180 deg C-Shape The provided `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named Tail, is a straight tapered cylinder running along +X from (0, 0, 0) to (1.5, 0, 0). Open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from `scene.obj`. Radius tapers from 0.10 BU at the root (x=0) to 0.03 BU at the tip (x=1.5). 40 length segments x 12 circular segments, with cap fans at both ends - ~494 vertices and ~504 faces. Single polygroup. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, use Transpose Bend to curl the tail into a half-circle (180 deg arc) while keeping the root anchored. Export the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj`. The exported `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` must satisfy: Exactly one SubTool, named Tail. Face count and vertex count preserved exactly (Bend never adds or removes topology). Every vertex with original x approx 0 (root ring) has displacement < 0.001 BU - the root is anchored. Endpoint chord divided by original arc length (= 1.5) equals 2/pi approx 0.6366 within 5% - confirming a 180 deg C-shape. Centerline discrete curvature stdev < 0.1 (curvature is approximately constant along the bend).

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
